sloka: अरण्य भूता इव पुरी सारथे प्रतिभाति मे ।न हि अत्र यानैः दृश्यन्ते न गजैः न च वाजिभिः ॥२-७१-२४॥
transliteration: araṇya bhūtā iva purī sārathe pratibhāti me ।na hi atra yānaiḥ dṛśyante na gajaiḥ na ca vājibhiḥ ॥2-71-24॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Important people mounted on elephants or horses are not seen going out of the city or coming in.
